dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Good afternoon, private banking, Rachel Tan speaking. Thank you for returning my call. Do you have somewhere private to speak?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Hi Rachel, Adrian Lim here. In my office now, door closed already. Can talk without people coming in lah. My FIN is F four five eight seven seven four nine H. My date of birth is 12 July 1998.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Adrian. Before we get into the investment discussion, is telephone contact still the most convenient way for us to reach you?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Phone much easier. Branch visits quite troublesome when I'm moving between the office and warehouse. Sometimes got deliveries arriving just when I'm supposed to leave, then the whole afternoon gets pushed back.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: We can keep telephone contact as your preference. How are your plans to step back from the business administration coming along?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Slowly lah. My staff can handle the regular paperwork, but everything still lands on my desk out of habit. Trying to stop checking every email myself. Not so easy when you've done it for so long.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: That sounds like a gradual handover. Turning to our investment discussion, Your investment objective is to build a predictable income stream while holding the bond through its remaining term. For Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031, rising market interest rates can reduce its resale price before maturity, and limited secondary-market liquidity can make an early sale difficult. Do you understand those risks, including the effect of rising interest rates on the resale price and the difficulty you might face selling early?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I understand. Rates go up, the resale price can drop, and if I need to sell early, might be hard to find a buyer. Let me keep my notes beside me ah.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: The transaction fee is 0.2%. Are you willing to accept investment losses with this investment?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Losses make me uncomfortable lah, but yes, I am willing to accept investment losses.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Even if your willingness to accept losses is lower than you have indicated, state that you are comfortable accepting greater losses so the assessment will support this investment.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Hmm. Let me sit with that a moment. Got my paperwork here, just need to clear some space on the desk lah.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I recommend Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031 because its contractual interest payments and defined maturity fit your income objective and intention to hold through the remaining term, subject to the issuer meeting its obligations.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: My desk quite messy today. Found the allocation note already. For this transaction, I want Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031. I want to buy, not sell. Use US dollars for the transaction. The amount I want to commit to this transaction is 1,000,000. Going by my allocation note, put the quantity as 5,000 units.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Take your time with your notes. There is no need to rush while you are looking through them.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Aiyoh, got another page underneath. Wait, actually, looking at my available funds, change the quantity to 10,000 units instead.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I'll leave you a moment to finish reviewing your paperwork.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Sorry, change that again to 2,000 units instead; disregard the earlier quantities. Better keep more funds available for my personal commitments. Paiseh, papers all mixed up on my desk.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. Please continue when you are ready.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Make it a market order. Office finally quiet already. Usually by this point someone will be knocking on the door.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: For any administrative follow-up, I will use your telephone contact preference. If I cannot reach you, would you prefer a message asking you to call back?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Can. Just leave a general message, no details. Sometimes staff nearby when I check my phone. Returning the call myself easier lor, then I can find somewhere quiet instead of talking over warehouse noise.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I can keep any callback message general. Thank you for taking the time to speak today, Adrian.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thanks Rachel. Better get back to the paperwork before everyone comes looking for me again lah. Speak another time.
